spans.s:
प्ररक्ष् प्र-रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -रक्षति, -रक्-
षितुम्, to protect against, protect, defend.

प्र-रक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one from whom any one
is protected.
प्र-रक्षण, अम्, n. protecting, protection.

प्र-रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, protected against, pro-
tected, defended.

प्ररथम् प्र-रथम्, ind., see Gaṇa Tish-
ṭhadgv-ādi to Pāṇ.

प्ररम् प्र-रम्, Caus. P. -रमयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to delight or gladden greatly, exhilarate; to
excite, arouse (?) .

प्रराधस् प्र-राधस्, आस्, m. (fr. rt. राध्
with प्र), N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras.

प्र-राध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satisfied or made
content.

प्ररिच् प्र-रिच्, Pass. -रिच्यते, to excel,
surpass, be superior to (with abl.).

प्र-रिक्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. reaching beyond,
surpassing, excelling.

प्र-रेक, अस्, m., Ved. abundance, plenty, afflu-
ence; (Sāy.) = दान, bounty, liberality.

प्र-रेचन, अम्, n., Ved. superabundance, super-
fluity (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाधिकं धनम्).

प्ररुच् प्र-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते, -रोचितुम्,
to shine forth, shine, be brilliant.

प्र-रोचन, अस्, ई, अम्, exciting or inciting to
love (as a spell), seducing; (अम्), n. stimulating,
exciting; seduction; illustration, explanation; (अम्,
आ), n. f. praising an author in the prologue of a
drama, favourable description of that which is to
follow in a play.

प्ररुज् प्र-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, -रोक्तुम्,
Ved. to break down, break (Sāy. = प्र-भञ्ज्).

प्र-रुज, अस्, m., N. of a mythical being con-
quered by Garuḍa; N. of a Rākṣasa.

प्ररुद् प्र-रुद्, cl. 2. P. -रोदिति, -रोदितुम्,
to burst into tears, begin to weep, weep, cry.

प्र-रुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, beginning to weep,
wept, weeping.

प्ररुध् प्र-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि,
-रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to keep back, hold back.

प्ररुह् 1. प्र-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्,
to grow up, shoot forth, shoot up, grow; to heal up
(as a wound).

2. प्र-रुह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shooting forth, growing up
like a plant; (ट्), f., Ved. a shoot, a new branch.

प्रारुह् प्रा-रुह् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति,
-रोढुम्, to ascend, rise.

प्र-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, full-grown;
grown, increased; growing or proceeding from a
root, rooted, fastened; born, produced.
—प्ररूढ-
केश, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘long-haired,’ one whose hair has
grown long, having long hair.
—प्ररूढ-शालि, इस्,
m. full-grown rice.
प्र-रूढि, इस्, f. growing up, growth, increase.
प्र-रोधन, अम्, n., Ved. rising, ascending.

प्र-रोह, अस्, m. growing or shooting forth [cf.
दृढ-प्˚]; germinating, germination, sprouting,
budding; a bud, shoot, sprout, twig, spray, sprig; a
shoot of light [cf. प्रभा-प्˚]; a new leaf or branch;
an excrescence.
—प्ररोह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-
sessing vegetation, covered with vegetation.

प्रारोह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-रोह), one who is
[]
used to rise or ascend; (अस्), m. a shoot, sprout, a
new branch or leaf (= प्र-रोह).

प्र-रोहण, अम्, n. growing or shooting forth,
growing, growth; germinating, germination, bud-
ding, sprouting; a bud, twig, spray, shoot, sprig.

प्र-रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, growing or shooting up,
growing, propagated (Manu

).
—प्ररोहि-
शाखिन्, ई, m. a tree whose branches grow again,
(perhaps rather) a tree still growing or still alive.

प्ररेज् प्र-रेज्, cl. 1. A. -रेजते, &c., Ved. to
tremble at (with acc.; Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण कम्प्).

प्रर्क्षीय प्रर्क्षीय (fr. 1. प्र + ऋक्ष),
Nom. P. प्रर्क्षीयति, &c., see Vopa-deva
II. 4

;
(also प्रार्क्षीय.)

प्रार्क्षीय प्रार्क्षीय (fr. प्र + ऋक्ष), Nom.
P. प्रार्क्षीयति = प्रर्क्षीयति, q. v.

प्रर्षभीय प्रर्षभीय (fr. 1. प्र + ऋष-
भ), Nom. P. प्रर्षभीयति, &c., see Scholiast
on Pāṇ.
; (also प्रार्षभीय.)

प्रार्षभीय प्रार्षभीय (fr. प्र + ऋषभ),
Nom. P. प्रार्षभीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रर्षभीय,
q. v.

प्रार् प्रार् (प्र-ऋ), cl. 3. P. प्रेयर्ति, &c.,
Ved. to go forth, go, move; to set in motion, pro-
duce: Caus. प्रार्पयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion,
stir up, animate.

प्रार्पण, अस्, m., Ved. one who stirs up or
animates.
प्रार्पण प्रार्पण. See under प्रार्, col. 1.

प्रारभ् प्रा-रभ् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रभते,
-रब्धुम्, to begin, commence, undertake.

प्रा-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, begun, commenced,
beginning; (अम्), n. an undertaking.

प्रा-रब्धि, इस्, f. beginning, commencement;
the post to which an elephant is fastened.

प्रा-रम्भ, अस्, m. beginning, commencement;
an undertaking, enterprise.
प्रा-रम्भण, अम्, n. beginning, commencing.

प्रार्च् प्रार्च् (प्र-अर्च्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्चति,
प्रार्चितुम्, to praise, celebrate in hymns (Sāy. =
स्तुति-रूपाभिर् वाग्भिः पूज्); to honour, worship:
Caus. प्रार्चयति, -यितुम्, to praise, honour.

प्रार्ज् प्रार्ज् (प्र-अर्ज्), Caus. P. प्रार्जयति,
यितुम्, to cause to acquire; to grant, bestow.

प्रार्जयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who grants or
bestows; (used to explain पर्जन्य, Nirukta

प्रार्जुन प्रार्जुन (प्र-अर्˚), आस्, m. pl., N.
of a people.

प्रार्ण प्रार्ण (प्र-ऋण), अम्, n. a chief or
principal debt.

प्रार्थ् प्रार्थ् (प्र-अर्थ्), cl. 10. A. (rarely
also P. and according to some grammarians regarded
as a Nom. fr. अर्थ with प्र), प्रार्थयते (-ति),
-यितुम्, to wish for, desire, require, want; to ask
for, beg for, pray for, request, solicit, ask any one
for anything (with two acc.); to wish or want to do
anything (with inf.); to pray, prefer a suit or peti-
tion, make a request.

प्रार्थ (प्र-अर्˚), अस्, m., Ved. (perhaps) fur-
niture, gear, harness, apparatus, equipment.

प्रार्थक, अस्, इका, अम्, wishing for, asking,
desiring, soliciting, begging, an asker, solicitor; a
suitor, petitioner, candidate; अ-प्रार्थक-वर, a
bridegroom who has not been a suitor [cf. Kullūka
on Manu
III. 27

प्रार्थन, अम्, आ, n. f. desire, wish; longing
desire for; requesting, asking, begging; supplication,
suit; prayer, entreaty, request, application, petition
(the object may be expressed by the loc., e. g. रुक्-
मिण्याम् अस्य प्रार्थना, his petition or suit for
Rukmiṇī; or precedes प्रार्थन in a comp., cf.
अनुज्ञा-प्˚); प्रार्थनया, ind. at the request or
petition of (any one).
—प्रार्थना-भङ्ग, अस्, m.
refusal of a request, asking in vain.
—प्रार्थना-
भाव (˚न-अभ्˚), अस्, m. absence of solicitation.
—प्रार्थना-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment of a
desire, fulfilment of wishes.

प्रार्थयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or
wished for, worthy of desire, desirable; असुलभ-
प्रार्थयितव्य, one the object of whose desire is
difficult of attainment.

प्रार्थयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who wishes for or
asks or solicits, an asker, inquirer, solicitor, impor-
tuner, beggar; a lover, wooer, suitor.

प्रार्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished for, desired, wished,
required, wanted; requested, solicited, asked for,
prayed for; killed, hurt; obstructed or opposed by
an enemy; attacked.
—प्रार्थित-दुर्लभ, अस्, आ,
अम्, desired but hard to obtain.
—प्रार्थित-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, one who has asked or begged; asking,
begging.

प्रार्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desiring, desirous of,
ambitious for; attacking, assailing, assaulting.

प्रार्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for
by any one (inst. or gen.); desirable; to be suppli-
cated, implored, petitioned, &c.
प्रार्दक, अस्, इका, अम्, making efforts.
प्रार्ध प्रार्ध (प्र-अर्˚) in परि-प्रार्ध, q. v.

प्रार्ष् प्रार्ष् (प्र-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्षति,
प्रार्षितुम्, to flow forth.

प्रार्ह् प्रार्ह् (प्र-अर्ह्), cl. 1. A. प्रार्हते,
प्रार्हितुम्, Ved. to distinguish or signalize one's
self.
